description: Pinned manifest of the Equinix Fabric MCP Server tool catalog, transcribed verbatim from the official documentation. This is the SDK's contract with the MCP server: McpCatalogTest locks every bridge-referenced tool name against it, and McpLiveProbeTest (-Plive-mcp) diffs the live tools/list against it to detect drift. Update this file ONLY from the official docs page, never to silence a failing test.
docsSource: https://docs.equinix.com/api-catalog (The Equinix API > MCP Servers > Fabric MCP Server)
notes: Delete functionality is not currently supported in the Fabric MCP Server (connections, ports, Cloud Routers).
Each tool corresponds to a specific Fabric API endpoint; apiEndpoint is the docs' link text for that endpoint.
The apiEndpoint values 'Get Metrics by Asset Id' (list_metrics_by_metros) and duplicated 'Get All Changes' / 'Get Change By ID' labels are transcribed as documented.
